channel.title: GiveOwl – Giveaways & sweepstakes in New Zealand
channel.description: Every listing links to the organizer’s official rules. GiveOwl never collects your entries.

item.title: Intrepid Travel New Trips competition: win a spot on a 2027 trip (AUD $11,000 each) – Intrepid Travel
item.description: Prize: Three prizes: a place on a new 2027 Intrepid trip (Sri Lanka, Thailand, Tasmania, Caucasus, Egypt or Barcelona to Berlin), return economy flights up to AUD $2,500, an Insta360 X5 camera and AUD $1,000 stipend, each worth AUD $11,000. Deadline: October 31, 2026. Global skill-based contest, not a random draw: submit an application on the Intrepid competition page telling them why you are the best pick for your chosen new 2027 trip. A panel judges the strength of the applications. Free, open to entrants worldwide aged 18+ (the terms say Global participants, so New Zealand residents can enter), unless entering is against the law where you live. 14 Oct to 31 Oct 2026 (11:59pm AEDT)

item.title: Masport: win a Pro Power 870 AL 3'N1 self-propelled lawnmower – Masport
item.description: Prize: One Masport Pro Power 870 AL 3'N1 self-propelled lawnmower (one winner in New Zealand, one in Australia), worth about NZ$1,199. Deadline: October 31, 2026. Enter on the Masport competition page (or the Typeform link it gives for NZ). Entry condition: you must complete the Masport newsletter sign-up and consent to Masport marketing emails; unsubscribing afterwards does not invalidate the entry. Free, one entry per person, Australian and New Zealand residents aged 18+, one winner per country. 1 to 31 Oct 2026, draw 12 Nov. The winner agrees to take part in promoting the competition (photo/interview)

item.title: Swish Fashion: win a AUD $500 Spring/Summer wardrobe voucher – Swish Fashion
item.description: Prize: One AUD $500 Swish Fashion gift voucher, redeemable online or in store on full-priced Spring/Summer 2026 items. Deadline: October 31, 2026. Sign up on the Swish Fashion giveaway page. Entry condition: you must consent to Swish Fashion email and SMS marketing (promotions and cart reminders; unsubscribe any time). Free, open to Australian and New Zealand residents aged 18+. Entries close 11:59pm AEST on 31 Oct 2026, draw 10 Nov

item.title: Are Media: Chance to Play to Win $100,000 (ELLE, Homes to Love, Country Style and more) – Are Media
item.description: Prize: Entry into a game to win AUD $100,000 (major prize), AUD $10,000 or AUD $2,500; New Zealand winners play the game by Zoom and are paid to an Australian bank account. Deadline: November 1, 2026. Open an Are Media entry page (this one is ELLE Australia, an Australian site; the same game runs on other Are Media sites) and fill in the entry form (name, date of birth, email, mobile, gender, state). Free, one entry per person per eligible website per day, residents of Australia and New Zealand aged 18+. 13 Jul to 1 Nov 2026 (11:59pm AEDT), draw 4 Nov. Marketing opt-in is optional (terms say by opting in)

item.title: Hallensteins: win a trip to Samoa for 2 (worth about NZ$5,000) – Hallensteins
item.description: Prize: Return economy flights for two from Australia or New Zealand to Apia plus five nights in a Deluxe Villa at Saletoga Sands Resort & Spa, Samoa, with daily breakfast, total value about NZ$5,000. Deadline: November 1, 2026. Sign up to the Hallensteins email list through the competition entry (entry condition: you must sign up to the Hallensteins email database; people already on the list are entered automatically). Free, New Zealand and Australian residents aged 21+. 13 Oct to 1 Nov 2026 (11:59pm NZT), draw 2 Nov. Flights must be booked through Hallensteins and blackout dates apply

item.title: White & Co. x Mitchelton: win a luxury getaway for four – White & Co.
item.description: Prize: Two nights for four at Mitchelton (Nagambie, Victoria) with spa treatments, dining and a Webjet voucher, AUD $500 car hire payment and four AUD $250 White & Co. gift cards, total value AUD $5,870. Deadline: November 5, 2026. Complete the entry form on the White & Co. competition page. Entry condition: you must give express consent to White & Co. marketing by email and SMS (withdrawing it later does not invalidate the entry). Free, one entry per person, legal residents of Australia and New Zealand aged 18+. 9 Oct to 5 Nov 2026 (11:59pm AEDT), draw 9 Nov. The prize is valued in AUD and the getaway is at Mitchelton in Victoria, Australia; it includes alcohol (18+)

item.title: Win a Wellington getaway: Jesus Christ Superstar tickets + night at Sojourn Ghuznee – Sojourn Hotels
item.description: Prize: Two tickets to Jesus Christ Superstar at St James Theatre, Wellington (28 Nov 2026) plus one night for two at Sojourn Ghuznee. Deadline: November 7, 2026. Complete the entry form on the Sojourn Hotels page. Free, one entry per person, no purchase necessary, open to NZ residents 18+. Opens 19 Oct, closes 11:59pm 7 Nov 2026

item.title: MiNDFOOD: win 1 of 10 double passes to «How to Rob a Bank» – MiNDFOOD
item.description: Prize: Ten double passes to the film How to Rob a Bank (in cinemas 12 Nov, NZ$40 per pass, total NZ$400). Deadline: November 8, 2026. Fill in the entry form on the MiNDFOOD competition page (details plus an answer of max 25 words to the question «Got any big, exciting plans on the horizon for the next year?»). Free, no purchase necessary, open to New Zealand residents only; the newsletter tick-boxes are optional. 9 Oct to 8 Nov 2026 (10pm AEST), winners judged by 9 Nov. Note: the terms print the close date as 08/10/2026, which is a typo; the judging date 9 Nov and the competition listing point to 8 Nov

item.description: Prize: Two tickets to FEAST at Sea with Kārena and Kasey Bird, a sunset harbour sailing from Auckland's Viaduct during Auckland FEAST (12–22 Nov 2026), worth NZ$310. item.title: Your Home and Garden: win a Haier 9kg 600 Series MultiWash front loader – Your Home and Garden (Are Media) og Haier
item.description: Prize: One Haier 9kg 600 Series MultiWash Front Loader washing machine worth NZ$2,899, delivered by Haier. Deadline: November 11, 2026. Enter your details in the form on the Your Home and Garden page. Free, one entry per person, New Zealand residents aged 18+. Closes 11:59pm 11 Nov 2026, draw 13 Nov

item.title: Bella Boheme: win 1 of 2 Ultimate Girls Getaways (worth AUD $5,000 each) – Bella Boheme
item.description: Prize: Two prize packages for two, each worth AUD $5,000: AUD $1,000 Bella Boheme voucher per person, two nights at Ardour Lilianfels (Blue Mountains) or Elysium Manly, spa treatment, dinner and return economy flights from Australia or New Zealand to Sydney. Deadline: November 15, 2026. Fill in the entry form on the Bella Boheme giveaway page. Free, no purchase necessary, open to Australian and New Zealand residents aged 18+. 19 Oct to 15 Nov 2026 (11:59pm AEDT), draw 16 Nov

item.title: Experience Gold Coast «Get Up and Gold Coast»: win a $5,008 Gold Coast holiday – Experience Gold Coast
item.description: Prize: Gold Coast holiday package worth AUD $5,008: Webjet voucher, JW Marriott Gold Coast accommodation voucher, Experience Oz voucher, Langham Chuan Spa voucher, hot air balloon voucher and dining vouchers. Deadline: November 15, 2026. Complete the entry form on the Experience Gold Coast promotion page (name, email, mobile, date of birth, postcode) and opt in to marketing emails. Free, one entry per person, residents of NSW, VIC, SA and New Zealand aged 18+. 15 Oct to 15 Nov 2026 (11:59pm AEDT)

item.title: LUXBMX Dream Build Giveaway: win your dream BMX build up to AUD $5,000 – LUXBMX
item.description: Prize: The BMX the winner designs in the LUXBMX bike builder, assembled by the LUXBMX workshop, up to AUD $5,000 retail value; delivery to Australia or New Zealand paid by LUXBMX. Deadline: November 15, 2026. Enter on the LUXBMX Dream Build page: build a bike in the bike builder, then give your details and a 25-word answer on what BMX means to you. Free, one entry per person, open to people living in Australia or New Zealand (13+, under 18 need parent permission). Entering joins the LUXBMX email list. 14 Oct to 15 Nov 2026 (11:59pm AEST). Judged on creativity

item.title: Muscle Republic $24K Ultimate Adventure Holiday Giveaway – Muscle Republic
item.description: Prize: One AUD $20,000 Arrival voucher, two AUD $2,000 Qantas flight vouchers and 15 AUD $500 Arrival vouchers (total AUD $31,500). Deadline: November 18, 2026. Fill in the entry form on the Muscle Republic giveaway page (name, phone, email) and opt in to email and SMS. Free, one entry per person, Australian or New Zealand residents aged 18+. 18 Sep to 18 Nov 2026 (3pm AEST), draw 19 Nov

item.title: Viking "Your Choice 2026": win a $20,000 future cruise voucher – Viking River Cruises
item.description: Prize: A $20,000 future cruise voucher for any Viking river, ocean or expedition voyage departing in 2027 or 2028. Deadline: November 30, 2026. Fill in the entry form on the Viking page (name, email, country). No purchase necessary, residents of Australia or New Zealand aged 18+, one entry per email. Starts 5 Aug 2026; the Conditions of Entry (clause 4) and the headline say the promotion ends 11.59pm AEDT on 30 Nov 2026 (a sidebar on the same page says 22 Nov, so enter early). Draw 7 Dec 2026

item.title: Loansmart Smart Saver Prize Draw: win one of five NZ$300 meat packs – Loansmart
item.description: Prize: Five prizes of a NZ$300 meat pack, delivered (urban delivery or rural pickup point). Deadline: December 7, 2026. Subscribe on the Loansmart Smart Saver page. Entry condition: you must subscribe to the weekly Smart Saver emails (8 short weekly tips for Christmas and January; unsubscribe any time). Free, one entry per person, no purchase, loan application or advice appointment needed, New Zealand residents aged 18+. Closes 7 Dec 2026, five winners drawn 10 Dec

item.title: Whenua Roots Christmas Mega Giveaway: festival tickets and prize packs – Whenua Roots og DLISH PIES Aotearoa
item.description: Prize: Two tickets each to Kingston Calling (Feb 2027), Mānuka Phuel SYNTHONY (Mar 2027) and Jim Beam Homegrown (Apr 2027), plus a DLISH PIES® prize pack and a Whenua Roots prize pack. Deadline: December 17, 2026. Complete the official entry form on the giveaway page. Free, no purchase necessary, one entry per person, NZ residents 18+. Entries close 11:59 pm NZDT on 17 December 2026; winner drawn 18 December

item.title: Vivo: win up to 8 haircut and colour services (up to NZ$4,000) – Vivo Hair Salons
item.description: Prize: Up to 8 cut and colour services at Vivo salons, worth up to NZ$4,000 (max NZ$500 per visit, redeemable within 12 months). Deadline: December 19, 2026. Complete the Vivo VIP quiz on the competition page and submit your email. Free entry, no need to join VIP, NZ residents aged 18+. 9 Oct to 19 Dec 2026, draw 20 Dec

item.title: Bunnings Courtside Access: win NBL courtside experience for your kids (NZ) – Bunnings New Zealand
item.description: Prize: Up to 8 New Zealand winners (4 per NZ NBL game, 2 games): meet and greet with NBL players, 7 NBL game tickets (2 adult, 5 child) with Bunnings merchandise and a post-game court session for the kids, worth about NZ$1,000 each (NZ pool NZ$8,000). Deadline: December 27, 2026. Fill in the online entry form on the Bunnings New Zealand Courtside Access page: pick your favourite NBL team and tell Bunnings in 50 words or less why you want to nominate your Young Baller. Free, one entry per person, residents aged 18+ who are parent or guardian of a child aged 8-15 on the game date. 30 Sep to 27 Dec 2026. Judged on merit

item.title: Royal Collection Trust: Win a Buckingham Palace Christmas Hamper – Royal Collection Trust
item.description: Prize: Buckingham Palace Christmas Hamper (£150), posted worldwide. Deadline: December 1, 2026. Fill in your details on the Royal Collection Shop competition page; one entry per person/email, no purchase. Postage paid worldwide. Closes 1 Dec 2026, 23:59 GMT

item.title: The Nature Photography Contest 2026 – The Nature Photography Contest
item.description: Prize: €2,000 in cash prizes. Deadline: November 15, 2026. Upload nature photos on the contest website. Open internationally

item.title: 24 Days of DHL Virtual Advent Calendar 2026 – Deutsche Post DHL
item.description: Prize: Not confirmed for 2026 (2025: daily prize draws with prizes that changed each day). 2025: answer the day's question and fill in the entry form; each door stays open 48 hours. 18+
